description: PetroActive FPS session telemetry used in the Kaggle Cognitive Mechanics benchmark. Single-player mech exploration with mouse, keyboard (WASD), view, and HUD input capture. Each event carries a container (MOUSE/KEYBOARD/VIEW/HUD/WORLD) and a layerWeight (precomputed cognitive weight).

sessions.label: s01 - Radar telemetry first test
sessions.notes: First radar telemetry test. 5 waypoints, all cancelled - exploratory testing.

sessions.label: s02 - Radar orientation fix test
sessions.notes: Radar pointer orientation fix test. 4 waypoints, all cancelled - distances 319-939m.

sessions.label: s03 - First successful arrival
sessions.notes: First successful waypoint arrival. Calibrated from 724m to 196m to 123m targets.
